title: Published Python library with a pinned and an unpinned dependency
why: Protects PyPI requirement parsing, the pinned-version PackageVersion identity split, and the LIBRARY_PACKAGE classification that must not fire when deployment configuration is present.

facts.note: unpinned range resolves to package identity only
an exact pin earns a PackageVersion identity

absent_facts.note: a >= range is not an observed exact version and must not be recorded as one
